```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "setup.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "config.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "metrics.R"), echo = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "survey.R"), echo = FALSE)

# One tab per round below. Round ids are set in config.R.
jun <- survey_results[["2025-06"]]
dec <- survey_results[["2025-12"]]
```

### Community Pulse Survey

The **Community Pulse Survey** is circulated periodically with four short questions to gauge member sentiment and the value Collaboratory provides. Select a tab below to view results from each round.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## June 2025

**`r jun$n` responses** received: `r jun$languages`.

Collaboratory's **Net Promoter Score: `r jun$nps_score`** — Promoters (`r jun$promoters`%), Passives (`r jun$passives`%), Detractors (`r jun$detractors`%).

#### Member Satisfaction

```{r}
#| label: satisfaction-chart-2025-06
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(jun$satisfaction, aes(x = Satisfaction, y = pct)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, fill = collab$brand) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")),
            hjust = -0.1, size = collab_size$label) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(title = "Member Satisfaction", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_collab_hbar()
```

#### Collaboratory Value

Members take value from the following areas offered by Collaboratory. The highest value offering is **`r tolower(jun$top_offering_label)` at `r round(jun$top_offering_pct)`%**.

```{r}
#| label: value-chart-2025-06
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(jun$value, aes(x = Question, y = pct_signed, fill = Response)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette, name = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = question_labels) +
  labs(
    title = "Have the following Collaboratory offerings added value to your work?",
    x = "", y = ""
  ) +
  theme_collab_hbar("bottom")
```

### Trends at a Glance

A directional comparison between the two survey rounds. Note: the rounds had different sample sizes (`r dec$n` in `r dec$label` vs `r jun$n` in `r jun$label`), so shifts should be interpreted as indicative rather than definitive.

::: {.collab-table}

| Metric | `r jun$label` | `r dec$label` | Direction |
|:-------|----------:|--------------:|:---------:|
| Net Promoter Score | `r jun$nps_score` | `r dec$nps_score` | `r trend_html(dec$nps_score, jun$nps_score)` |
| Positive Satisfaction | `r round(jun$sat_positive, 1)`% | `r round(dec$sat_positive, 1)`% | `r trend_html(dec$sat_positive, jun$sat_positive)` |
| Responses | `r jun$n` | `r dec$n` | `r trend_html(dec$n, jun$n, cfg$trend_threshold_count)` |

:::
